biome: all (NPC accessory, attaches to installed humanoid cast)
author: Claude (coordinator-side Meshy NPC-accessory worker), owner-authorized Meshy use (Standing owner direction 1, 15 Oct 2026)
workflow: agent-drafted multi-view concept from the repo key art (Meshy image-to-image nano-banana-pro, reference as data URI) -> inspected -> Meshy image-to-3d (latest, quad remesh, target 2500, PBR textures embedded) -> Meshy remesh (triangle topology, target 3600) to meet the <4k-triangle budget -> embedded textures resized to 1024 px JPEG -> lossless metres normalisation -> origin moved to the attach point

native_size.note: Meshy remesh GLB, longest side ~1.9 units

scale_normalisation.method: lossless: GLB scene roots wrapped in node 'metres_root' with uniform scale + translation; base at y=0, footprint centred on x/z, then translation shifted so the attach point is the origin
scale_normalisation.source_glb: Meshy remesh output (triangle topology, target 3600) of the chosen image-to-3d model, textures re-encoded

texture_repack.method: every embedded image resized to <=1024 px and re-encoded JPEG q92 (Meshy remesh baked 2048-4096 px PNG)

origin.attach_point: sits-on-head point inside the crown: crown axis, y 0.333 m (0.015 m under the inner crown top at 0.348 m; the hat is open underneath)
origin.note: normalised frame = base at y=0, x/z centred; origin_offset is added to every vertex (glTF +y up, Meshy front faces +z)

previews: preview_meshy.png (Meshy thumbnail of the image-to-3d source model)
preview_3view.png (software flat-shaded 3-view of the final GLB, colours sampled per face)
files.raw_glb: not published (Meshy image-to-3d and remesh outputs kept only as task ids)

concepts.prompt: A mustard-yellow fisherman's sou'wester rain hat, glossy oilskin, rounded crown, brim long at the back and shorter at the front, stitched seams, two short chin ties. Hat only, empty, no head. Style: Palworld / Animo-class stylised game asset, chunky simplified readable silhouette that reads at 15 metres, slightly oversized key shapes, soft hand-painted PBR materials, warm natural palette taken from the reference key art (honey wood, warm brass and copper, slate blue, teal, mustard, moss green, cream). Single isolated object only, floating on a plain flat light-grey background, no ground, no shadow scene, no character, no body, no hands, no mannequin, no text, no logo. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon, no crimson, no pink anywhere. Show the same object from three views: front, three-quarter and side, consistent design.
references: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MJohnsonWellabe/Tetherbound/main/docs/reference/tetherbound-meadows-keyart.png (1536 x 1024 source re-encoded as JPEG q90 at 1536 px; local derived file keyart_1536.jpg): project palette and stylised finish
concepts.verdict: CHOSEN (view 2, side three-quarter showing the longer back brim): glossy mustard oilskin, panelled crown with seams, brim, two chin ties

models.kept: source for remesh r1 only; raw GLB not published

visual_verdict.text: Mustard oilskin rain hat with panel seams, a wide brim and two chin ties; open underneath with a real interior. The crown is tall and round, so the profile sits between a sou'wester and a pith helmet; the brim is only slightly longer at the back. Readable as a fisher's rain hat by colour and ties.

integration_note: candidate only; stays flag-off until its scene passes code-blind judging
palette_check: base-colour texture scan of the final GLB (hue <= 12 or >= 320 deg, sat >= 0.35, val >= 0.2): 0.00% of texels, all dark shaded copper/wood edge texels, no red/oxblood/pink surface
